title: `notes:2026.txt` is a plain path on POSIX (the `<prefix>:` form is removed)
notes: §12 item 29: the `<prefix>:` form is removed, so `notes:` is not stripped: on POSIX the create targets the ordinary path `notes:2026.txt`, not the existing `2026.txt` (no E600, no E201). On Windows a colon in a path is E100 (see `paths-colon-E100-windows`), so this case runs on POSIX only; it runs under --check so that no file with a colon is created. See AMBIGUITIES R17.
